notebooks.title: 候选的完整响应

cells.code:
print('versions numpy,scipy,control',np.__version__,scipy.__version__,ct.__version__)
t=np.arange(2001)/100
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(7,6))
for name,C in controllers.items():
    T=ct.feedback(C*G);U=ct.feedback(C,G)
    tt,y=ct.step_response(T,t);_,u=ct.step_response(U,t)
    assert np.max(abs(y-(1-error(name,t))))<1e-9
    assert np.max(abs(u-command(name,t)))<1e-9
    print(name,'poles,DC',ct.poles(T),ct.dcgain(T))
    print(name,'PM,wc',ct.margin(C*G)[1],ct.margin(C*G)[3])
    rise=np.inf if name=='P4' else brentq(lambda t:error(name,t)-.1,0,30)-brentq(lambda t:error(name,t)-.9,0,30)
    print(name,'residual,target10to90,t_epsilon,u_peak',.2 if name=='P4' else 0.,rise,settling(name,1,.02),u_peak(name,1))
    print(name,'y20 finite sample',y[-1])
    axes[0].plot(t,y,label=name)
    axes[1].plot(t,u,label=name)
for ax,ylabel,limits in zip(axes,['y','u'],[[-.05,1.1],[0,4.3]]):
    ax.set(xlim=(0,20),ylim=limits,xlabel='t (s)',ylabel=ylabel);ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout();plt.show()
# Independent state realization keeps both PI modes including the stable cancellation.
for kp in [1.,2.]:
    A=np.array([[-1-kp,1.],[-1.,0.]]);print('PI state roots',kp,np.linalg.eigvals(A))

notebooks.title: 四份合同的筛选

cells.code:
for label,A,eps,limit,deadline in contracts:
    print('contract',label,'A,epsilon,input_limit,deadline',A,eps,limit,deadline)
    passed=[]
    for name in controllers:
        ts=settling(name,A,eps);peak=u_peak(name,A)
        ok=bool(np.isfinite(ts) and ts<=deadline and peak<=limit)
        print(name,'continuous entry time,peak,pass',ts,peak,ok)
        if ok:passed.append(name)
    print('accepted fixed candidates',passed)
    expected={'A':['PI11','PI21'],'B':['P4','PI11','PI21'],'C':['PI11'],'D':[]}[label]
    assert passed==expected
# Exponential error coefficients are positive: entry is permanent, not just a first crossing.
assert a>0 and b>0 and c>0 and 1-c>0
for name in controllers:
    eps=.06;A=.25;ts=settling(name,A,eps)
    assert abs(A*error(name,ts)-eps)<1e-10
    assert A*error(name,ts+.1)<eps
print('D reachable upper bound at t8',.5*(1-np.exp(-8)))
print('D asymptotic upper bound .5, required lower band',1-.02)
# The equality epsilon=residual is approached only at infinity for P4.
assert np.isinf(settling('P4',1,.2))
